_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for CHTR (Charter Communications, Inc., CIK 1091667), generated by retro/generators/chtr/gen_chtr.py from the filings; every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after its 'published' date (EDGAR's acceptance time in ET: accepted at or after 16:00, the next trading day). It holds what decides whether a date can be built under method r2, and nothing else: each 10-K vintage's Item 6 EPS history, the listing record and the price basis. Every period of 1999-2013 is a loss per share except the Predecessor's eleven months to 2009-11-30 (the Plan and fresh start gains) and the Successor's first month (December 2009), neither of them a year, so no date of 2008-2013 has a full year of positive EPS to anchor a P/E and none is built (retro/README.md, "CHTR 2008-2009"). No print, guide, dividend, signal or theme event is transcribed (no dividend was paid: 'no_dividend' quotes the 10-Ks), and the builder refuses any date that passes the gate until they are.
price_basis: Yahoo's CHTR series is the Successor's Class A common stock from its first point, 2010-01-05 (firstTradeDate; the stock quoted on the OTC Bulletin Board as CCMM from December 2009 and listed on NASDAQ as CHTR from 2010-09-14). Yahoo serves no close of the Predecessor's Class A common stock (NASDAQ: CHTR to 2009-04-06, then the OTC Bulletin Board or the Pink Sheets to its cancellation on 2009-11-30) under CHTR or any other symbol read (CHTRQ, CCMM: not found).

Charter’s Class A common stock is quoted on the OTC Bulletin Board under the symbol “CCMM.” The stock began being quoted on the Bulletin Board in December 2009 following our emergence from Chapter 11 proceedings.
listings.quote_predecessor: Prior to April 6, 2009, Predecessor common stock traded on the NASDAQ Global Select Market. From April 7, 2009 through the Effective Date, shares of common stock of Predecessor traded on the OTC Bulletin Board or in the “Pink Sheets.” On the Effective Date, all of the outstanding common stock and all other outstanding equity securities of Predecessor were cancelled pursuant to the terms of the Plan.
